body: R51b landed (301ae3f). The Aging.gd contract you consume is UNCHANGED - birth_week_for / band_for / peak_window / year_step / retirement_pressure, same signatures, same constants. Nothing in C34 needs a rebase for it. Two facts for your side: GameState now writes status 'retired' on world athletes it retires out of the player's roster (id kept, gym_id blank, retired_week set), so treat an existing retired world athlete as already handled rather than re-retiring it; and J10 (John's study) landed the same day but is NOT folded in - do not author J10's numbers into WorldPopulation, the fold is one operator decision away and belongs in Aging.gd only.
